an2.42:1.3: Uttānā ca parisā gambhīrā ca parisā.
an2.42:1.5: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū uddhatā honti unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇa-vācā muṭṭhassatī asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhanta-cittā pākatindriyā --
an2.42:2.2: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū anuddhatā honti anunnaḷā acapalā amukharā avikiṇṇa-vācā upaṭṭhitasatī sampajānā samāhitā ekaggacittā saṃvutindriyā --
an2.42:2.5: Etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ parisānaṃ yadidaṃ gambhīrā parisā ti. 2. Dve 'mā
an2.43:1.3: Vaggā ca parisā samaggā ca parisā.
an2.43:1.5: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalaha-jātā vivādāpannā aññamaññaṃ mukha-satthīhi vitudantā viharanti --
an2.43:2.2: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññaṃ piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharanti --
an2.43:2.5: Etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ parisānaṃ yadidaṃ samaggā parisā ti. 3. Dve 'mā
an2.44:1.5: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ therā bhikkhū bāhulikā honti sāthalikā vokkamane pubbaṅgamā paviveke nikkhitta-dhurā na viriyaṃ ārabhanti appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya
an2.44:1.7: sā pi hoti bāhulikā sāthalikā vokkamane pubbaṅgamā paviveke nikkhitta-dhurā na viriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an2.44:2.2: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ therā bhikkhū na bāhulikā honti na sāthalikā vokkamane nikkhitta-dhurā paviveke pubbaṅgamā viriyaṃ ārabhanti appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya
an2.44:2.4: sā pi hoti na bāhulikā na sāthalikā vokkamane nikkhitta-dhurā paviveke pubbaṅgamā viriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an2.44:2.7: Etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ parisānaṃ yadidaṃ aggavatī parisā ti. 4. Dve 'mā
an2.45:1.5: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti ayaṃ dukkhanirodho ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti ayaṃ dukkhanirodha-gāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti --
an2.45:2.2: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ bhikkhū idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti ayaṃ dukkhanirodho ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti --
an2.45:2.5: Etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ parisānaṃ yadidaṃ ariyā parisā ti. 5. Dve 'mā
an2.46:1.5: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū chandāgatiṃ gacchanti dosāgatiṃ gacchanti mohāgatiṃ gacchanti bhayāgatiṃ gacchanti --
an2.46:2.2: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū na chandāgatiṃ gacchanti na dosāgatiṃ gacchanti na mohāgatiṃ gacchanti na bhayāgatiṃ gacchanti --
an2.46:2.5: Etad aggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ parisānaṃ yadidaṃ parisamaṇḍo ti. 6. Dve 'mā
an2.47:1.3: Ukkācita-vinītā parisā no paṭipucchā-vinītā paṭipucchāvinītā parisā no ukkācitavinītā.
an2.47:1.4: Katamā ca bhikkhave ukkācita-vinītā parisā no paṭipucchā-vinītā?
an2.47:1.5: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū ye te suttantā Tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīratthā lokuttarā suññatāpaṭisaññuttā tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsanti na sotaṃ odahanti na aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññanti,
an2.47:1.6: ye pana te suttantā kavikatā kāveyyā cittakkharā cittavyañjanā bāhirakā sāvakabhāsitā tesu bhaññamānesu sussūsanti sotaṃ odahanti aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti te ca dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññanti, te taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā na c' eva aññamaññaṃ paṭipucchanti na paṭivivaranti
an2.47:1.8: Te avivaṭañ c' eva na vivaranti anuttānī-katañ ca na uttānī-karonti anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhānīyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ na paṭivinodenti.
an2.47:1.9: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ukkācita-vinītā parisā no paṭipucchā-vinītā.
an2.47:2.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave paṭipucchā-vinītā parisā no ukkācita-vinītā?
an2.47:2.2: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū ye te suttantā kavikatā kāveyyā cittakkharā citta-vyañjanā bāhirakā sāvaka-bhāsitā tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsanti na sotaṃ odahanti na aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññanti.
an2.47:2.3: Ye pana te suttantā Tathāgatabhāsitā gambhīrā gambhīratthā lokuttarā suññatā-paṭisaññuttā tesu bhaññamānesu sussūsanti sotaṃ odahanti aññācittaṃ upaṭṭhāpenti te ca dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññanti
an2.47:2.4: te taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā aññamaññaṃ paṭipucchanti paṭivivaranti
an2.47:2.6: Te avivaṭañ c' eva vivaranti anuttānīkatañ ca uttānīkaronti anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭhānīyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.
an2.47:2.7: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave paṭipucchāvinītā parisā no ukkācita-vinītā.
an2.47:2.9: Etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ parisānaṃ yadidaṃ paṭipucchāvinītā parisā no ukkācita-vinītā ti. 7. Dve 'mā
an2.48:1.3: Āmisagarū parisā no saddhammagarū saddhammagarū parisā no āmisagarū.
an2.48:1.4: Katamā ca bhikkhave āmisagarū parisā no saddhammagarū?
an2.48:1.5: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū gihīnaṃ odātavasanānaṃ sammukhā aññamaññassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti
an2.48:1.6: asuko bhikkhu ubhato-bhāga-vimutto asuko paññāvimutto asuko kāyasakkhī asuko diṭṭhippatto asuko saddhāvimutto asuko dhammānusārī asuko saddhānusārī asuko sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo asuko dussīlo pāpadhammo ti:
an2.48:1.8: te tena taṃ lābhaṃ labhitvā gathitā mucchitā ajjhopannā anādīnavadassāvino anissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti.
an2.48:1.9: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave āmisagarū parisā no saddhammagarū.
an2.48:2.1: Katamā ca bhikkhave saddhammagarū parisā no āmisagarū?
an2.48:2.2: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū na gihīnaṃ odātavasanānaṃ sammukhā aññamaññassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsanti
an2.48:2.3: asuko bhikkhu ubhato-bhāga-vimutto asuko paññāvimutto asuko kāyasakkhī asuko diṭṭhippatto asuko saddhāvimutto asuko dhammānusārī asuko saddhānusārī asuko sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo asuko dussīlo pāpadhammo 'ti:
an2.48:2.5: te taṃ lābham pi labhitvā agathitā amucchitā anajjhopannā ādīnavadassāvino nissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti.
an2.48:2.6: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave saddhammagarū parisā no āmisagarū.
an2.48:2.8: Etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ parisānaṃ yadidaṃ saddhammagarū parisā no āmisagarū ti. 8. Dve 'mā
an2.49:1.3: Visamā ca parisā samā ca parisā.
an2.49:1.5: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ adhammakammāni pavattanti dhammakammāni nappavattanti avinayakammāni pavattanti vinayakammāni nappavattanti adhammakammāni dippanti dhammakammāni na dippanti avinayakammāni dippanti vinayakammāni na dippanti
an2.49:1.6: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave visamā parisā. Visamattā bhikkhave parisāya adhammakammāni pavattanti dhammakammāni nappavattanti avinayakammāni pavattanti vinayakammāni nappavattanti adhammakammāni dippanti dhammakammāni na dippanti avinayakammāni dippanti vinayakammāni na dippanti.
an2.49:2.2: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ dhammakammāni pavattanti adhammakammāni nappavattanti vinayakammāni pavattanti avinayakammāni nappavattanti dhammakammāni dippanti adhammakammāni na dippanti vinayakammāni dippanti avinayakammāni na dippanti --
an2.49:2.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave samā parisā: samattā bhikkhave parisāya dhammakammāni pavattanti adhammakammāni nappavattanti vinayakammāni pavattanti avinayakammāni nappavattanti dhammakammāni dippanti adhammakammāni na dippanti vinayakammāni dippanti avinayakammāni na dippanti.
an2.49:2.5: Etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ parisānaṃ yadidaṃ samā parisā ti. 9. Dve 'mā
an2.50:1.3: Adhammikā ca parisā dhammikā ca parisā . . . pe (8) . . . Imā kho bhikkhave dve parisā.
an2.50:1.4: Etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ parisānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammikā parisā ti. 10. Dve 'mā
an2.51:1.3: Adhammavādinī ca parisā dhammavādinī ca parisā.
an2.51:1.5: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyanti dhammikaṃ vā adhammikam vā
an2.51:1.6: te taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyitvā na c' eva aññamaññaṃ saññāpenti na ca saññattiṃ upagacchanti na ca nijjhāpenti na ca nijjhattiṃ upagacchanti.
an2.51:1.7: Te asaññattibalā anijjhattibalā appaṭinissaggamantino tam eva adhikaraṇaṃ thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa voharanti
an2.51:1.8: idam eva saccaṃ mogham aññan ti --
an2.51:2.2: Idha bhikkhave yassaṃ parisāyaṃ bhikkhū adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyanti dhammikaṃ vā adhammikaṃ vā
an2.51:2.3: te taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyitvā aññamaññaṃ saññāpenti c' eva saññattiñ ca upagacchanti nijjhāpenti c' eva nijjhattiñ ca upagacchanti
an2.51:2.4: te saññattibalā nijjhattibalā paṭinissaggamantino na tam eva adhikaraṇaṃ thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa voharanti
an2.51:2.5: idam eva saccaṃ mogham aññan ti --
an2.51:2.8: Etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ parisānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammavādinī parisā ti. Tatr' -uddānaṃ:--
an2.51:3.4: visamā adhammādhammiyena vā ti. Paṭhamo paṇṇāsako samatto.12 1. Dve 'me
